Name: Miihau's Abigail Event Expansion
Author: Miihau
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Tested to work with 1.6 ✓[/b]
[/size][b]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

[size=3]This mod aims to add more depth to the character[color=#f4cccc] [/color][b][color=#b4a7d6]Abigail[/color][/b]. There are [b][color=#b4a7d6]10 additional heart events![/color][/b]
I tried to keep this mod [b][color=#b4a7d6]lore/stardew friendly[/color]
[/b]looking to flesh out Abigail's already established traits like:
the desire to adventure, playing music, being into gaming, being into magical stuff, having a bad relationship with Pierre >:(

Q: Can I make a [color=#f1c232]translation of/expand on[/color] this mod?
A: [color=#6aa84f]Yes![/color] Please read the permissions and credits tab first! (no AI)
please make sure to use the correct i18n format.

[b]
[/b][/center][b]I recommend talking to the NPCs involved in the events after the events (or the following day) to get even more content[/b]

(I made the event requirements easier in the newer version. if you use a old version refer to here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2271]old requirements[/url])

1 Heart Event:
[i](At the Mountains; from 11:30am to 6:00pm; Player has entered the mines at least once)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]The Mines?:[/b]
You find Abby in front of the mines. She seems to be interested but is unsure to share her interest with you. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

2 Heart Event:
[i](In Town; from 9:00pm to 11:00pm; event 1 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Graveyard Encounter:[/b]
You run into Abby late at the Graveyard. She didn't expect you there but is presently surprised to see you in such an unorthodox place, she shares her interest in Adventure Stories and the excitement of exploring places. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

3 Heart Event:
[i](In the Saloon; from 7:30pm to 10:00pm; event 2 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Arcade Games:[/b]
Abby, Sebby and Sam are in the saloon Playing arcade games she's a bit bummed because she got a lower score than both of them. They invite you to hang out. Sam and Sebby play pool while you and Abby talk on the couch about gaming. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

4 Heart Event:
[i]([i]At Pierre's Store;[/i] event 3 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Pierre >:( :[/b]
You enter the General store while Abby helps out, She drops something and Pierre lashes out on her. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

5 Heart Event:
[i](At Pierre's Store; event 4 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Jamming Support:[/b]
You enter Abby Room while she next to her drum set, she tells you about the small band she has with Sam and Sebastian. She is uncertain if she is pulling her weight in the band and asks you for your judgement on her drumming. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

6 Heart Event:[i]
(In Town; from 9:00pm to 10:30pm; event 5 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Running away:[/b]
You walk past the general store at the evening. You hear loud screaming from inside. and see Abby rushing out. you sit down with her by a near bridge and listen to her vent about her father not supporting her and being so old fashioned/believes in old gender roles. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

7 Heart Event:
[i](At the Mountain; from 9:00pm to 10:30pm; event 6 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Sword practice:[/b]
You Find Abby near the mountains at night practicing her with her sword. She tells you about her passion for adventuring which started when she was very little. she remembers going to the Stardew Valley Fair and spending all day by the display of the Adventures Guild. Her parents, especially her father never supports her passion for adventuring. It's like they never been young. but she is certain her mother loved to venture out to the forest before she was born. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

8 Heart Event:[i]
(In the Forest; from 2:00pm to 6:00pm; event 7 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Wizard Tower:[/b]
You find Abigail near the wizards Tower. She tells you that she feels a strong connection to this place but is unsure why. she tells you about her passion for everything supernatural and mysterious. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

9 Heart Event:
[i](You get mail that needs to be read before the event)[/i]
[i](In the Forest; from 10:00pm to 2:00am; event 8 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Camping Date:[/b]
Abigail invites you to a late-night camping date in the woods. Her parents finally agreed to her going on an "adventure". Abigail thanks the player on the positive impact they had on her life. The Player spends the night with abigail in a tent. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]

10 Heart Event:
[i](You get mail that needs to be read before the event)
(At the Mountain; from 8:00pm to 11:00pm; event 9 had to be seen)[/i]
[SPOILER][b]Romance:[/b]
Abigail invites you to visit her after dark by the Adventurers Guild. she plays a flute solo she has written for you. after that she comes closer to you and tells you about how she finally was able to join the Adventurers Guild. she pours her heart out to you. ending in a kiss. (play to find out more)[/SPOILER]
